item.tib: rtsa gsum bder gshegs kun 'dus rig 'dzin stong rgyung mthu chen gyi skong ba mkha' gsang rol pa'i gter chen
item.coloph: ces pa'i rtsa gsum bder gshegs kun 'dus rig 'dzin bder gshegs kun 'dus rig 'dzin stong rgyung mthu chen gyi skong ba nyung 'thus mkha' gsang rol pa'i gter chen 'di yang / snying slob rnam rgyal phun tshogs lags nas 'di ltar dgos zhes bskul ngor/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin thugs kyi snying bu shel skyes tshe dbang bde chen snying pos shar grol smin gling du 'phral du spel nas phul ba 'dis kyang / gyer bstan rin po che phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
